create_LambdaFilter: create a LambdaFilter instance with a callable that returns True or False for each Document
filter_Document: filter a Document using a LambdaFilter by applying a custom predicate function
build_LambdaFilter_exclusion: build a LambdaFilter with an exclusion_writer to log filtered-out documents
test_LambdaFilter: test the LambdaFilter class by passing a Document and verifying the filter function result
refactor_LambdaFilter: refactor the LambdaFilter class to support additional metadata-based filtering criteria
